control_flow: followInTheDark: if dark, steer by the line (below 90 % curve left, above 90 % curve right, otherwise avoidWalls); if bright, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if dark, turn away from an obstacle on the left or right, else call driveInTheDark; if bright, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dark, drive forward at 30 %; if bright, call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: on black curve left, otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, and keep following it in the dark inside a tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor LLIGHT reads less than 70 %: it is dark

branches.outcome: dark: it steers by the line

decision_points.condition: inside the dark part: first the line tracker reads less than 90 %, then more than 90 %

branches.outcome: below 90 % (black core or plain floor): it curves left, wheels 10 % and 30 %
above 90 % (white band): it curves right, wheels 30 % and 10 %

branches.reason: The line tracker reads 90 % only for a moment at the edge of a line: no test can put the robot there.

branches.reason: avoidWalls is only reached in bright light, except from the line reading exactly 90 %; the light is read again at once and no time passes.
branches.outcome: dark: it looks at the side obstacle sensors

decision_points.condition: in avoidWalls in the dark: first an obstacle on the left, then on the right

branches.reason: Only reachable inside the dark branch of avoidWalls, which needs the line tracker to read exactly 90 %.
branches.outcome: an obstacle on the left: it turns right 20°

branches.outcome: an obstacle on the right: it turns left 20°

branches.reason: Only reachable inside the dark branch of avoidWalls, which needs the line tracker to read exactly 90 %.
branches.outcome: no obstacle on either side: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: in driveInTheDark: is it dark (LLIGHT less than 70 %)

branches.reason: driveInTheDark is entered only in bright light, and the light is read again at once, so it is still bright there.

decision_points.condition: in stopAtWall: is an obstacle ahead

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine

decision_points.condition: in followLine: does the line tracker see black

branches.outcome: black: it curves left, wheels 10 % and 40 %
no black: it curves right, wheels 40 % and 10 %
